title: Restaurant menu items
scope: All 71 dine-in menu appearances / 60 distinct item IDs in the eight native Food & Drink completion restaurants. Takeout and large-portion tables are outside this scope.
textPolicy: Description is the installed English-patched dine-in shop row text, not the item.bin inventory description. Raw text and exact pointers are retained. Only CRLF/CR newline encoding is normalized for render text; no wording is paraphrased. Use offers[].description for the exact shopId-specific line breaks. Name trims boundary whitespace only; nameRaw is verbatim.
blankPolicy: A genuinely blank menu description remains an empty string; no inventory fallback or invented text.

guideChecklist.file: Private reviewed guide-checklist snapshot; the source snapshot is not included in this public repository.

schemaCorroboration: The private shop-inventory extractor uses the same >HHIII row schema; its extraction tooling is not included in this public repository.
The private save-sync extractor uses the same shopeat_comp.bin item arrays and completion-bit order; its extraction tooling is not included in this public repository.
The private forging-material extractor uses item.bin key/name/description/icon columns 0/7/9/23; its extraction tooling is not included in this public repository.
